name: es2/侠客行（南京河海大学校内版1.01）
english_name: Eastern Story II x Xiake Xing (Hohai University Campus Edition)
english_description: A hybrid of the ES2 and Xiake Xing ('The Wandering Knight') engine lineages, built as a computer-science-department test build at Hohai University in Nanjing, with a standard shared wuxia sect map (Shaolin, Wudang, Huashan, Taishan, Mingjiao, Beggars'-Sect, Peach-Blossom Island). The content is still a work in progress, but the world already has personality — the pawnshop owner in Snow Pavilion Town (安惜迩) is secretly a hidden master with far more combat prowess than any other early-game NPC, useful as a deliberately unbeatable trigger for testing the death-and-revival flow, while the doorkeeper at the Chunfeng martial arts hall (刘安禄) hides a real secret identity behind his everyday flavor text: ask him the right question — naming 'Bloody-Hand Liu San' — while you're experienced enough yourself, and he drops the disguise, reveals himself as the deputy chief of Wild-Goat-Mountain's bandits, and comes at you at more than double his original strength.
